name: InterContinental London Park Lane
insider_take: This grand dame of Mayfair sits on one of London's most prestigious corners, where royalty once strolled and modern luxury meets timeless elegance.
whats_special: Built in 1929 as one of London's first luxury hotels, the InterContinental Park Lane occupies a prime position overlooking Hyde Park Corner and Wellington Arch. The hotel's stunning Art Deco facade has welcomed everyone from Hollywood stars to heads of state, while its coveted location places you steps from Buckingham Palace, Harvey Nichols, and the exclusive boutiques of Bond Street.
pro_tip: Request a park-facing room on floors 7-8 for unobstructed views of Hyde Park and catch the Changing of the Guard ceremony at Wellington Arch right outside your window—it happens every morning at 11am.
dont_miss: The hotel's Cookbook Café offers one of London's best afternoon teas with park views, while the rooftop Wellington Lounge provides panoramic vistas across the Royal Parks. Take advantage of your location to explore Speaker's Corner in Hyde Park on Sunday mornings, or enjoy an evening stroll through the illuminated Wellington Arch tunnel that connects directly to Green Park.
pros: Prime Mayfair location directly across from Hyde Park
Luxurious rooms with elegant décor and premium amenities
Exceptional service standards with attentive concierge team
Award-winning dining options including Michelin-starred restaurant
cons: Premium pricing reflecting luxury Mayfair location
Historic building with some rooms featuring traditional layouts
